data.title: KSrelief Distributes 496 Food Baskets in Gaza
data.content:
Gaza, November 19, 2026, SPA -- The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 496 food baskets yesterday to support food security among families in need in Khan Younis and Deir Al-Balah in the Gaza Strip.
    The assistance benefited 2,976 people as part of the Saudi campaign to provide relief to the Palestinian people in Gaza.
    The distribution is part of Saudi Arabia's ongoing humanitarian efforts to meet the needs of affected families and alleviate their suffering.
    -- SPA
